lede: A sample project, so the OSS site page bodies have something to show.

usage.caption: example.js
usage.code:
import { greet } from "@example/core";

console.log(greet("world")); // hello, world

features.title: Fast to read
features.body: Each page leads with what the project does for the reader.

features.title: Accessible
features.body: WCAG 2.2 AA in light, dark, and forced colors.

features.title: Quiet by default
features.body: No script is needed to read any page.

features.title: Easy to restyle
features.body: Custom properties and unlayered CSS beat every packaged layer.
